_doc: The living half of this page. The card's address is burned in and can never change, so this page is the only place anything new can land. Adding an entry is a JSON edit and a deploy — never a new page and never a new URL. Newest first. This file arrived 2026-08-16, the day a build gate started refusing any page a card points at that has no way to change. BILINGUAL FROM 2026-08-17. Every entry carries both halves. The page's "Words for you" section promises the words "in both, the way we actually say them", and the log — the one section that grows — was English only, so the promise held for everything on the page except the part a second visit is for. Order is not chosen here: build_site.py reads <html lang> from index.html, finds "en", and leads in English with the Spanish underneath, the same way the card's ink is set.

entries.body_en: Someone asked for something they'd actually use, so this page now has a land converter. Type one number and get acres, square feet, square metres, hectares, manzanas and cuerdas — both manzanas, Nicaragua's and Guatemala's, since they differ.
entries.body_es: Alguien pidió algo que de verdad sirviera, así que esta página ahora tiene un convertidor de tierra. Escribe un número y salen acres, pies y metros cuadrados, hectáreas, manzanas y cuerdas, con manzana nica y chapina por separado, porque no miden igual.
entries._audit_body_en: Wish 68ae0757 (vibe_card_wishes, 2026-08-18T22:32Z, card TIERRA-TRAZO-001, text 'show m something i'd actually use'). Shipped L3636: a converter section after the three careers, all units through square metres once (acre = 4046.8564224 m2 international; ft2 = 0.09290304 m2; ha = 10000 m2; manzana select 7042.25 m2 Nicaragua per en.wikipedia Manzana_(unit) / 6987.29 m2 Guatemala per en.wikipedia Metrication_in_Guatemala (vara 0.8359 m) / 7000 rounded; cuerda = side^2 x 0.8359^2 m2, sides 20/25/30/32/40/50 per en.wikipedia Cuerda whose table uses the 0.8359 vara even where its prose says 0.8421 — 436.71 m2 at 25 is the check). The Nicaraguan manzana is published at 6,987 (Castilian vara), 7,026 (common), 7,042.25 (Wikipedia), 7,044 (gowebtool) and 7,050.124 (1902 decree); spread 0.9%, so the page says 'about' and offers the rounded 7,000 as well. Declined nothing. Same commit: this page's #vc-card license field MIT -> null, matching NOTICE:126 which withholds the artwork (raices got the same fix 2026-08-16 in 38b8d5b; tierra/nica/sala did not — helios #15192 H1).

entries.en: No card file said how big it was
entries.body_en: Every card picture here left its own size out, so printing at 100% depended on your software guessing. A Mac guessed 72 dpi and printed the card 713 mm wide.
entries.es: Ningún archivo de la tarjeta decía su tamaño
entries.body_es: Todas las imágenes de la tarjeta salían sin su tamaño, así que imprimir al 100% dependía de lo que adivinara tu programa. Una Mac adivinaba 72 dpi y sacaba la tarjeta de 713 mm de ancho.
entries._audit_body_en: Measured 2026-08-17, chunk by chunk with struct over the raw bytes: NOT ONE of the 110 card PNGs in this repo carried a pHYs chunk — 62 in examples/*/designs, 24 in src/web/cards, 24 in src/site/*/card-*.png. So no consumer could read a physical size and each used its own default; macOS ImageIO assumes 72 dpi, making the 2022 px trim file 713.3 mm wide, the 2066 px bleed file 728.8 mm, and the 1100 px preview 388.1 mm. THIS ENTRY REPLACES ONE WRITTEN HOURS EARLIER THE SAME DAY WHICH WAS ALSO WRONG, and the error is the more instructive half: it said the previews print 'about half size', 46.57 x 29.38 mm, which is what you get IF something declares 600 dpi. Nothing did. A number derived from an undeclared assumption reads exactly like a measured one. FIXED AT THE SOURCE: tools/intake_card.py now passes dpi= on all three Pillow saves (600 on the trim and bleed pair, and for the preview a value derived from its real pixel width — 1100/85.6*25.4 = 326 — so a future thumbnail size cannot keep a stale number), and the 110 existing files were stamped by inserting a 21-byte pHYs chunk after IHDR rather than re-encoding, because re-encoding would recompress irreplaceable card artwork. Pixels are byte-identical and the QR still decodes 69 of 69. At 100% the print pair now measures 85.60 x 53.98 mm exactly and the preview 85.70 x 54.07 mm, inside the +/-0.2 mm the sheet already allows. The four pages that instruct printing — lab, raices, sala, tierra — carried the bold rule 'Print at 100%. Never fit to page.' throughout; it was the failure, and it is now true.

entries.en: This page could not change until today
entries.body_en: The address on the card is fixed, so this page is the only place anything new can ever land. It had no logbook until today — now it does, and this is its first entry.
entries._audit_body_en: Measured 2026-08-16: five of the fourteen node pages in this site — tierra, raices, nica, sala, lab — carried no <!--ENTRIES--> marker, no entries.json and none of the .entry CSS, so their living half was absent rather than empty. Every one answered 200 in every destination sweep, against a control that 404s: the sweep answers 'does this URL land', not 'can this page ever say anything new'. These five are the example cards — qr rows decoded from shipped design files; the card ledger records no physical instance — while every card that HAS been printed already had a living page. tools/build_site.py now fails a build where a page named by a resolves_to in this site carries no marker, which is the gate that forced this file to exist.
entries.es: Esta página no podía cambiar hasta hoy
entries.body_es: La dirección de la tarjeta es fija, así que esta página es el único lugar donde puede aparecer algo nuevo. Hasta hoy no tenía bitácora; ya la tiene, y ésta fue su primera entrada.
